## 6. Accurate service-description facts

Approved factual direction:

- Bed bug inspection is active.
- Bed bug treatment is active.
- Residential and commercial pest control are active.
- Roach and rodent control are active.
- Fumigation is active.
- Bed bug positioning should emphasize targeted treatment of affected furniture/items and specific areas rather than expensive whole-home heat treatment.

Hard restrictions:

- Termite service is coming soon, not currently available.
- Wildlife removal is not offered.
- Do not claim whole-home bed bug heat treatment.
- Do not promise guaranteed elimination, one-visit resolution, exact savings, or unsupported fixed pricing.

## 10. Post-verification checks

- [ ] Apple place card displays the correct business name.
- [ ] Map pin or service-area representation is accurate.
- [ ] Phone and website open correctly.
- [ ] Hours and holiday hours are accurate.
- [ ] Categories match actual services.
- [ ] Images are current and properly cropped.
- [ ] Action links reach the intended secure page.
- [ ] No prohibited service claim appears.
- [ ] Apple provider/location identifier is stored in AI Edge OS without credentials.
- [ ] Verification date, operator, and evidence reference are recorded.
